name: eai-2026-pa5-shared
description: PA5 shared/ — connection helper + canonical order type, mounted read-only into every service container. Deliberately self-contained (its own node_modules) so it resolves 'amqplib' from its own directory regardless of which service mounts it or how deep that service nests its own src/ — see docs/adr-004.md and the comment at the top of ../docker-compose.yml.
